evidence_type: Restricted original-SPSS survey analyses summarized for public scholarly communication
manuscript_status: Revised author manuscript; not asserted published or peer reviewed

primary_OLS.reported_HC3_source: Revised researcher-supplied manuscript and independent reanalysis cited therein

ml_validation.model_configuration: Fixed exploratory settings; no outcome-driven search
ml_validation.error_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of fold RMSE / MAE / R2
ml_validation.shap: Out-of-fold observations from first 5-fold repetition, one held-out explanation per participant

reproduction_limitations: The raw SPSS .sav records are restricted and not stored or linked in this repository.
Aggregate evidence was independently derived from author-provided private analysis outputs; this repository does not itself reproduce the empirical estimates without authorized original records.
Repeated folds overlap and are not independent confidence-interval replications.
No external institutional test, causal identification or prospective policy evaluation.
Participant-level SHAP and scatterplots are not publicly released.
